{1: 'KURONO VESSEL, SHIP CABIN', 2: 'NORTHERN WATERS, TRANSATLANTIC ECONOMIC COMMUNITY TERRITORY'}
{2: 'LOCATION: KURONO VESSEL, SHIP CABIN. NORTHERN WATERS, TRANSATLANTIC ECONOMIC COMMUNITY TERRITORY.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Clausen', 3: 'So? How did the connection go? You got Moses up and running, right?', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Adelyde', 3: "It wasn't that smooth. New problems came up almost right away.", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Clausen', 3: 'New problems...', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Clausen', 3: "Don't tell me the explosion was one of them.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: "The explosion came later, but let me walk you through it in order. Moses did connect to the master AI, but I couldn't activate its full functionality.", 4: '2'}

{2: 'Adelyde', 3: "The four nodes and the master AI aren't set up as a hierarchy. They're symbiotic. To bring Moses fully online, I had to locate the other three and connect them all to the master AI.", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'Only when all four nodes are in place can the master AI issue unified commands across every module.', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'So to accomplish my mission objective, I decided to head for the other nodes...', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Clausen', 3: 'The other nodes... Then what was inside them...?', 4: '1'}

{2: 'Adelyde', 3: "Captain Clausen, I know exactly why this ship is really here. Officially, you're my extraction. Unofficially, Kurono ordered you to recover every scrap of intel and every last clearance related to the Millennium Project from me.", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'Am I wrong?', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'Ever since the Red Tide started spilling from the Atlantic Eye, Babylonia has been locked in negotiations with the TEC. The interests tangled up in this are staggering.', 4: '2'}

{2: 'Adelyde', 3: "But unlike Babylonia, which wanted to resolve things immediately, the TEC's leadership refused to disclose all their intel. Too many interests at stake. It made any follow-up operations extremely difficult.", 4: '2'}

{2: 'Adelyde', 3: "Kurono, though, is in a different spot. You negotiated your own arrangements with the TEC leadership through your own channels. But having to deal with partners who push back doesn't sit well with you.", 4: '2'}

{2: 'Adelyde', 3: "So to gain leverage for the next round of talks, you need more bargaining chips. And the reason you're sitting here listening to my story is simple: this unexpected Millennium Project is the perfect chip.", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Clausen', 3: "And so what if you've figured us out, Lieutenant Colonel? You're on my ship. If you're thinking of holding anything back—", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: "I'm giving you everything. The entire Millennium Project. Moses included.", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Clausen', 3: 'Did I hear that right?', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'My objective was never about power struggles. It was about doing whatever I could to contain this crisis. If we keep locking horns here, we both lose.', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Clausen', 3: "So if you're handing it all over, that means you've already linked up every node. Is that what you're telling me?", 4: '1'}

{2: 'Adelyde', 3: "That's right. Once I understood the symbiotic link between the nodes and the master AI, I followed the signal traces the satellites had picked up and located the second node of the Millennium Project.", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'Deep-sea submersible units designated Symbiotic Siren.', 4: '2'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory391.jpg'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront12.png', 4: '4'}
{1: 'DialogDisable'}
{1: 'UNKNOWN WATERS, DEPTH: 500 METERS', 2: 'NORTHERN WATERS, TRANSATLANTIC ECONOMIC COMMUNITY TERRITORY', 4: 'SOMETIME EARLIER'}
{2: 'SOMETIME EARLIER. LOCATION: NORTHERN WATERS, TRANSATLANTIC ECONOMIC COMMUNITY TERRITORY. DEPTH: 500 METERS.'}
{3: "Thanks to the retrofit components recovered from the undersea base, Adelyde's submersible could now dive deeper than before."}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront12.png', 4: '4', 5: '1'}
{3: "As she descended, the darkness thickened around her until it felt almost solid. To avoid colliding with the rock walls, she turned the submersible's lights up to full brightness."}
{3: 'The beams tore through the ink-blue murk to expose her surroundings. She found herself moving through a colossal crevasse in the seabed, its ancient walls honeycombed by centuries of erosion.'}

{3: 'On the way down, she caught sight of waterlogged wood trapped in the crevices, carried here by currents from some forgotten place. Listless fish hung in the water, drifting with the tide and paying her no mind.'}
{3: 'The proximity alarm chimed as the seafloor neared, and Adelyde tilted the searchlight to face the depths below. A terrace of ochre sediment slowly emerged from the gloom.'}

{3: 'Dark clusters of starfish and other bottom dwellers crept across the mud, their bodies gathering in shifting patches. At first glance, the pale shapes beneath their limbs looked like the skeletal remains of whales or sharks.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory391.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.8'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory391.jpg'}
{3: 'But as the submersible crept closer, the truth revealed itself.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Adelyde', 3: "Symbiotic Sirens... they're all broken?", 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStorySandNew.prefab', 2: '2', 5: '11'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStorySandNew.prefab', 2: '2', 5: '13'}

{3: "The bottom dwellers carpeting the Siren's remains erupted outward all at once. A swirling cloud of disturbed silt and drifting marine snow swallowed her visibility whole. When the particles slowly drifted back down, the lights laid the entire scene bare before her."}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1301.jpg'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStorySandNew.prefab', 5: '11'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStorySandNew.prefab', 5: '13'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Adelyde', 3: "That's where the second node is. Or rather, was. It's a graveyard now.", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Clausen', 3: "You're saying all the Siren units at the second node were destroyed?", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'At least, everywhere I looked, there was nothing but their wreckage. I examined a few of the remains...', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: "And it didn't take long to understand how this place turned into a graveyard.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Clausen', 3: '...The Corrupted got to them?', 4: '2'}

{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'Pretty much. Some wrecks showed clear signs of Punishing Virus corruption. Others were still intact. But corrupted or not, every last one of them had exploration gear jammed into its frame. Same model, their own equipment.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Clausen', 3: 'Tsk... So they tore each other apart.', 4: '2'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory391.jpg'}
{1: 'DialogDisable'}
{1: 'NODE TWO, SIREN GRAVEYARD, DEPTH: 500 METERS', 2: 'NORTHERN WATERS, TRANSATLANTIC ECONOMIC COMMUNITY TERRITORY', 4: 'SOMETIME EARLIER'}
{3: 'SOMETIME EARLIER. LOCATION: NODE TWO, SIREN GRAVEYARD. NORTHERN WATERS, TRANSATLANTIC ECONOMIC COMMUNITY TERRITORY. DEPTH: 500 METERS.'}

{3: 'Observation from a distance could only tell her so much. If she wanted to learn what had truly caused the blackout and whether the node could ever reconnect to the master AI, she would have to reach a terminal herself.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Adelyde', 3: "This one's still mostly intact, and no sign of corruption. Still, I'm not taking chances. I'll sandbox it through a virtual system first, then connect.", 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: '...Connection successful. Virtual environment loaded. Node data access granted...', 2: 'ffffffff', 3: '1', 4: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1145.jpg', 7: '-2', 9: '1', 10: '1'}
{1: '...Retrieving project documentation: "Symbiotic Siren"...', 2: 'ffffffff', 3: '0.6', 4: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1145.jpg', 7: '1'}

{1: 'Symbiotic Sirens are deep-sea combat submersible units developed and mass-produced exclusively by the Spelmin family.', 2: 'ffffffff', 3: '0.8', 4: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1145.jpg'}

{1: "The project's initial objective was to address two critical challenges in extreme high-pressure deep-sea environments: cargo transport and high-speed maneuverability.", 2: 'ffffffff', 3: '0.8', 4: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1145.jpg'}

{1: 'The designation "Siren" reflects the research team\'s ambition: a mechanical fleet worthy of deep-sea myth, capable of commanding entire ocean territories through sheer power and presence.', 2: 'ffffffff', 3: '1.1', 4: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1145.jpg'}

{1: 'To maximize frame adaptability and expandability, the Spelmin family incorporated bionic technology. The resulting configuration is near-humanoid.', 2: 'ffffffff', 3: '1', 4: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1145.jpg'}

{1: "Consequently, the Symbiotic Siren's defensive weaponry and close-quarters combat capabilities far exceed standard units deployed in other nodes of the Millennium Project.", 2: 'ffffffff', 3: '1', 4: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1145.jpg'}

{1: "The Spelmin family designated the Sirens as the project's dedicated defensive battle force. Their assigned roles are security, escort operations, and high-risk zone clearance in the event of a crisis.", 2: 'ffffffff', 3: '1.1', 4: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1145.jpg', 9: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Adelyde', 3: "In other words, the Sirens were meant to be the project's guardians... But before a crisis actually hits, no one can ever really predict what it's going to bring.", 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: '...Retrieving archive: "Node Shutdown"...', 2: 'ffffffff', 3: '0.5', 4: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1145.jpg', 6: '1', 7: '1'}

{1: "Ten days ago, following this node's autonomous assessment, the Siren fleet was deployed to the perimeter of the Atlantic Eye.", 2: 'ffffffff', 3: '0.8', 4: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1145.jpg', 6: '1'}

{1: 'The mission objective was to investigate the effects of the regional explosion and evaluate whether the resulting disaster posed a threat to the core Millennium Project.', 2: 'ffffffff', 3: '0.6', 4: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1145.jpg', 6: '1'}

{1: 'During the mission, some Siren units briefly surfaced to rescue survivors at sea. The observation mission continued for an extended period until the situation stabilized to an acceptable degree.', 2: 'ffffffff', 3: '1', 4: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1145.jpg', 6: '1'}

{1: 'Upon conclusion of the observation mission, all units returned to base. Shortly thereafter, multiple units began exhibiting malfunctions, including network dropouts, erratic movement, and other anomalies.', 2: 'ffffffff', 3: '1', 4: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1145.jpg', 6: '1'}

{1: 'Autonomous diagnostics, system reboots, and component replacements were attempted. All efforts failed to restore the compromised units.', 2: 'ffffffff', 3: '1', 4: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1145.jpg', 6: '1'}

{1: 'The unknown corruption continued to spread. Over half the fleet began displaying hostile tendencies, actively attacking other machinery.', 2: 'ffffffff', 3: '1.4', 4: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1145.jpg', 6: '1'}

{1: 'In accordance with core protocols, this node determined that the Symbiotic Siren fleet has become a critical threat to the project.', 2: 'ffffffff', 3: '0.6', 4: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1145.jpg', 6: '1'}
{1: 'Threat level assessed at Class A. A node-wide self-elimination protocol was initiated.', 2: 'ffffffff', 3: '0.6', 4: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1145.jpg', 6: '1', 9: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1301.jpg'}
{1: 'KURONO VESSEL, SHIP CABIN', 2: 'NORTHERN WATERS, TRANSATLANTIC ECONOMIC COMMUNITY TERRITORY'}
{2: 'LOCATION: KURONO VESSEL, SHIP CABIN. NORTHERN WATERS, TRANSATLANTIC ECONOMIC COMMUNITY TERRITORY.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Clausen', 3: 'So basically, some of the Sirens carried the Punishing Virus back to the node.', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Adelyde', 3: "That's right. The outbreak hit just as the observation mission was wrapping up. After that, the Symbiotic Siren node lost all connection to the master AI.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'With no higher intelligence left to assess the situation, they fell back on baseline protocols. And those protocols flagged them as a threat to the project.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'So there, in the dark depths of the abyss, the Sirens started hunting each other down, all to protect the Millennium Project.', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Clausen', 3: 'But you said you managed to link up all four nodes. Which means some Sirens are still    "alive" at the second node, right?', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Adelyde', 3: "...I pushed deeper into the search. That's when I came face-to-face with a Symbiotic Siren completely corrupted by the Punishing Virus.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: "My submersible had basic weapons, but the corrupted Siren's combat capability was way beyond what I'd estimated. Just as things were about to go wrong...", 4: '1'}

{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'Another Siren burst out of the silt, with only its upper half left. But it used everything it had left to pin the other one down. I took the opening and finished the Corrupted off with the submersible.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: "That's when I realized that the entire seabed had been under watch the whole time.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: "The uncorrupted Sirens had set up a thin perimeter net around the node. They'd been lying dormant in low-power sentry mode all along, waiting on guard.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: "The moment they detected a Corrupted, they'd activate and move to eliminate it.", 4: '1'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Clausen', 3: 'A coordinated defensive network... But you said after they disconnected from the master AI, they were running on nothing but baseline protocols. Without higher intelligence calling the shots, how do machines develop that kind of cohesion?', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'I was curious about the same thing, so I linked into the Siren that saved me.', 4: '1'}

{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'And I found something buried in its code. A hidden directive. Some programmer who worked for the Spelmin family wanted their batch of Sirens to stand out, so they slipped in an unauthorized rule. They called it "Principle Four."', 4: '1'}
{1: '"When necessary, abandon the project and survive at all costs!"', 3: '60', 4: 'ff4e4eff'}
{3: '"When necessary, abandon the project and survive at all costs!"'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'But that programmer\'s clearance was limited. They couldn\'t rewrite the core logic. The system safeguards kept rejecting the "abandon the project" part. But that obsession with survival in the second half took hold completely.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'I was about to study the Siren further when the others started stirring around me.', 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory391.jpg'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront12.png', 4: '4'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Adelyde', 3: "They ignored me entirely and swarmed the fallen Siren's wreckage, like scavengers and ghouls crawling across the deep sea floor. They tore that unit apart and stripped it for whatever parts and energy they could use.", 4: '18'}

{2: 'Adelyde', 3: "I turned up the searchlight and got a good look at the survivors. They'd been scavenging, patching, rebuilding themselves for so long just to keep going. Their frames were barely recognizable anymore.", 4: '18'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: "That programmer's command kept these Sirens alive. Kept the whole node alive. But it also became a curse, a leash that twisted them from Sirens into something monstrous.", 4: '18'}
{1: 'DialogDisable'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'Once the usable parts were picked clean, they scattered again. So I captured one and reconnected the whole group to the Abyss Passer master AI. Same as I did with Moses.', 4: '18'}

{2: 'Adelyde', 3: "The moment the link went through, something came across the comm channel between my submersible and the Siren's terminal. It was a deep voice, echoing up from the abyss...", 4: '18'}
{1: 'DialogDisable'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront12.png', 4: '4', 5: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png'}
{1: '"Helio, is that you?"', 3: '70', 4: 'ffffffff'}
{2: '"Helio, is that you?"'}
